theorem L1 (n : Nat) : ps_f1 n = n * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [ps_f1]
    rw [ih]
    have h : (n + 1) * (n + 1) = n * n + 2 * n + 1 := by
      rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_succ]
      omega
    rw [h]

theorem L3 (n : Nat) : 2 * ps_t n = n * (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show 2 * ps_t (n + 1) = (n + 1) * (n + 2)
    simp only [ps_t]
    rw [ih]
    ring

  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show ps_d (n + 1 + 1) = ps_t (n + 1)
    simp only [ps_d, ps_t]
    rw [ih]
    omega
